notes.title: Book 2 WIP
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
As some of you who have been following this game for a while know, I tend to post the WIP chapter by chapter.  You all know the drill of that one and I can't wait to see you all there.

For everyone that is new, if you are interested in reading the WIP format of the next book, I have the Introduction and Chapter one posted for early access on all tiers of my Patreon.  It will be available for free come November 1st. Follow my Tumblr for all the details.

Thank you to everyone for your support and I cannot wait to enjoy the next leg of the Night Market with you.

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/user?u=70509166&fan_landing=true&view_as=public

Tumblr: https://www.tumblr.com/night-market-if

Hey everyone!
